brief: A compact desk unit with a drawer, plus a spike at a corner where three bases meet to hold a small platform.

requirements.requirement: Compact desk unit (multiple bases forming a desk-sized cluster)
requirements.evidence: 4 bases placed: piece:0,0,0;full + piece:0,1,0;full + piece:1,0,0;full + piece:1,1,0;half-n creates a compact ~2x2 desk cluster. meshClash=clear.

requirements.requirement: Drawer integrated into the desk unit
requirements.evidence: drawer:0#1,1#cut installed on half-n base at 1,1,0 (socket key s on cut face). Provides drawer storage for desk unit.

requirements.requirement: Spike located at corner where three bases meet
requirements.evidence: spike:0#0,0|0,1|1,0 at junction of three full bases 0,0,0 + 0,1,0 + 1,0,0 - verified valid spike socket where three cells meet.

Spike variant mount with platform accessory set via setSpikeAccessory to platform-lrg (current) after initial platform-sm - provides small platform atop spike as required. Configurator accepted platform attachment.

finish.summary: Compact desk unit built from 4 bases with drawer on half base and mount spike with platform at triple junction. check_build ok true, meshClash clear. Warnings are non-blocking LOOSE_BODY (joint bolts optional) and OPEN_CAP_FACE info only.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
